info.title: Tic Tac Toe Backend
info.description: FastAPI backend providing minimal tic-tac-toe validation and outcome computation.

get.description:
Health check endpoint.

Returns:
    JSON object indicating the service is running.

post.description:
Validates whether a move is legal given the current board and player.

Rules enforced:
- board shape/values
- turn order based on counts (X starts, alternate)
- move index in range
- target cell empty
- game not already finished

post.summary: Compute tic-tac-toe outcome from a board
post.description:
Computes winner/draw information from the given board.

If the board is invalid (turn counts, etc.), the endpoint returns winner=null and isDraw=false.

board.title: Board
board.description: Board cells as an array of 9 strings: 'X', 'O', or '' (empty).

ComputeOutcomeRequest.title: ComputeOutcomeRequest
ComputeOutcomeRequest.description: Request payload for computing the outcome of a given board.

winner.title: Winner
winner.description: Winner of the game if there is one; otherwise null.

isDraw.title: Isdraw
isDraw.description: True if the game is a draw (no winner, board full).

winningLine.title: Winningline
winningLine.description: If there is a winner, the 3 indices of the winning line.

ComputeOutcomeResponse.title: ComputeOutcomeResponse
ComputeOutcomeResponse.description: Response payload describing the game outcome.

board.title: Board
board.description: Board cells as an array of 9 strings: 'X', 'O', or '' (empty).

moveIndex.title: Moveindex
moveIndex.description: 0-based index into the 9-cell board where the move is attempted.

ValidateMoveRequest.title: ValidateMoveRequest
ValidateMoveRequest.description: Request payload for validating a move on a given board.

valid.title: Valid
valid.description: True if the move is legal; otherwise false.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: If valid=false, a human-readable reason explaining why the move is invalid.

ValidateMoveResponse.title: ValidateMoveResponse
ValidateMoveResponse.description: Response payload describing whether a move is valid and optional reason when invalid.

tags.name: TicTacToe
tags.description:
Minimal tic-tac-toe helpers.

Design choice: Option (A) stateless utility endpoints.
This keeps the backend minimal and robust while allowing the frontend to manage state locally or implement its own storage later.
